info.title: BioAvanceD API
info.description: BioAvanceD backend API (RNF006 C2, #1325). This spec covers only the mounts listed in x-covered-mounts; the rest of the API is not yet documented here. Every response body is JSON with a boolean success; a failure carries error and, often, message. Outside the test environment every route sits behind the global rate limiter and /api/auth also behind the auth limiter, and a request over either limit answers 429.

post.summary: Open a temperature incident, or add to the one open for the sensor
post.description: Gates: none. The route registers no authenticate and no permission, so this operation is unauthenticated. The incident and quarantine answer at the top level, not under data. It does not open the request database (req.app.locals.db), so it never answers 503. An open, acknowledged or escalated incident for the sensorKey is updated; otherwise one is created and the alert recipients are mailed.

post.description: Gates: authenticate (router-wide), requirePermission('manageStorageTopology'), requireOrganizationScope. Errors answer { success: false, error: <code>, message }, and a 422 also carries details. An untagged error answers 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. The 503 comes from authenticate.

200.description: The registration with its new status.

409.description: The registration is not active, or changed during the operation (error REGISTRATION_INACTIVE).

get.description: Gates: authenticate (router-wide), requirePermission('viewEquipment'), requireOrganizationScope. Errors answer { success: false, error: <code>, message }, and a 422 also carries details. An untagged error answers 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. The 503 comes from authenticate.

parameters.name: sensorId
parameters.description: Only the datastreams of this sensor.

post.summary: Bind a sensor to what it observes
post.description: Gates: authenticate (router-wide), requirePermission('manageStorageTopology'), requireOrganizationScope. Errors answer { success: false, error: <code>, message }, and a 422 also carries details. An untagged error answers 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. The 503 comes from authenticate.

unit.description: A UCUM code, for example Cel.

201.description: The datastream; status active, or retired when validityPeriod.end is given.

409.description: The sensor already has a datastream of this observedProperty in that interval (error DATASTREAM_OVERLAP).

get.description: Gates: authenticate (router-wide), requirePermission('viewEquipment'), requireOrganizationScope. Errors answer { success: false, error: <code>, message }, and a 422 also carries details. An untagged error answers 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. The 503 comes from authenticate.

post.summary: End the validity of an open telemetry datastream
post.description: Gates: authenticate (router-wide), requirePermission('manageStorageTopology'), requireOrganizationScope. Errors answer { success: false, error: <code>, message }, and a 422 also carries details. An untagged error answers 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. The 503 comes from authenticate.

end.description: ISO 8601, exclusive; now when absent. It must be after validityPeriod.start.

409.description: The validity already ended, or ended during the operation (error DATASTREAM_ENDED).

post.summary: Create a sensor
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('manageSensor'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. The 400 includes a caller of several organizations who names no organizationId, and a thrown 403, which is answered as 400. The 404 is an organizationId that does not resolve. The 422 is a validation failure or an unknown samplingPolicyId.

sensorId.description: sensorID is read as an alias.

400.description: Invalid input or the operation failed; details lists the reasons when present.

get.summary: List the sensors in the caller's organization scope
get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('viewTemperature'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: Only this location; locationID is read as an alias.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('viewTemperature'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A sensor of another organization answers 403.

put.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('manageSensor'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A sensor of another organization, or a refused re-parent of organizationId, answers 403. Every other failure, validation included, answers 400, so there is no 422. status and sensorStatus are read as aliases of maintenanceStatus.

delete.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('manageSensor'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A sensor of another organization answers 403.

post.summary: Ingest one temperature reading from a device
post.description: Gates: requireMachineIngestSecret (header x-telemetry-ingest-secret). No authenticate, so it never answers 401, and it has no 404. The body is at the top level, not under data. 422 is an invalid timestamp, idempotencyKey, sequenceNumber or optional text field, or a reading the contract rejects. 503 is TELEMETRY_NOT_PERSISTED (the InfluxDB write was not confirmed), or a binding that cannot be verified in enforce mode (no code).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601; the receipt time when absent.

idempotencyKey.description: A non-empty text; a replay of an accepted key answers the first reading.

200.description: Accepted, or a replay of an idempotencyKey (replayed true, with the first reading's fields).

replayed.description: true on a replay of an idempotencyKey.

400.description: sensorId is missing, or temperature is not a finite number.

403.description: The machine-ingest secret is missing or wrong.

422.description: The reading is invalid; error carries the reason, with no details.

503.description: TELEMETRY_NOT_PERSISTED (code carries it), or the binding cannot be verified in enforce mode (no code).

post.summary: Test support: check for missing readings once
post.description: Gates: requireTestSupportSecret (header x-test-support-secret). No authenticate. Runs the telemetry monitor's missing-readings check. Registered only when NODE_ENV is not production and ENABLE_TEST_SUPPORT_ROUTES is true. A wrong secret answers 403; 503 is "telemetryMonitor não inicializado".

403.description: The test-support secret is missing or wrong.

post.summary: Test support: find the freezers in critical state
post.description: Gates: requireTestSupportSecret (header x-test-support-secret). No authenticate. The optional body fields override the monitor's settings for this call only. Registered only when NODE_ENV is not production and ENABLE_TEST_SUPPORT_ROUTES is true. A wrong secret answers 403; 503 is "telemetryMonitor não inicializado".

403.description: The test-support secret is missing or wrong.

post.summary: Test support: run a full telemetry monitor cycle
post.description: Gates: requireTestSupportSecret (header x-test-support-secret). No authenticate. Runs the full cycle; the optional body fields override the monitor's settings for this call only. Registered only when NODE_ENV is not production and ENABLE_TEST_SUPPORT_ROUTES is true. A wrong secret answers 403; 503 is "telemetryMonitor não inicializado".

403.description: The test-support secret is missing or wrong.

post.summary: Record a temperature reading
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('recordTemperature'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. 200 is a replayed idempotencyKey. 400 is an untagged failure, a caller of several organizations who names no organizationId, or a thrown 403. 404 is an unknown organizationId. A 503 is also TELEMETRY_NOT_PERSISTED or TELEMETRY_BINDING_UNVERIFIABLE, with code.

sensorId.description: sensorID is read as an alias.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601; the receipt time when absent.

policyId.description: When given, the reading is checked against this policy and may raise an alert.

idempotencyKey.description: A replay of a recorded key answers 200 with the first reading.

organizationId.description: Needed by a caller of several organizations.

400.description: The operation failed; details lists the reasons when present.

503.description: The database is not available (from authenticate), or the reading was not persisted (TELEMETRY_NOT_PERSISTED) or its binding cannot be verified (TELEMETRY_BINDING_UNVERIFIABLE); code carries those two.

post.summary: Record a temperature reading from a device
post.description: Gates: requireMachineIngestSecret (header x-telemetry-ingest-secret). No authenticate, so it never answers 401, and the controller's catch maps every failure to 400, 404, 422 or 503, so it never answers 500. The organization comes from the sensor, never from the body. 404 is an unknown sensorId or organization. 503 is the controller's own no-database branch, TELEMETRY_NOT_PERSISTED or TELEMETRY_BINDING_UNVERIFIABLE (code carries those two). 200 is a replayed idempotencyKey.

sensorId.description: sensorID is read as an alias.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601; the receipt time when absent.

policyId.description: When given, the reading is checked against this policy and may raise an alert.

idempotencyKey.description: A replay of a recorded key answers 200 with the first reading.

400.description: The operation failed; details lists the reasons when present.

403.description: The machine-ingest secret is missing or wrong.

503.description: The database is not available, the reading was not persisted (TELEMETRY_NOT_PERSISTED) or its binding cannot be verified (TELEMETRY_BINDING_UNVERIFIABLE).

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('viewTemperature'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate.

parameters.name: sensorId
parameters.description: Only this sensor; sensorID is read as an alias.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('viewTemperature'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate.
Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('viewTemperature'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate.

get.summary: Temperature readings for the control chart
get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('viewTemperature'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate.

parameters.name: sensorID
parameters.description: Only this sensor; sensorId is read as an alias.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('viewTemperature'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. An id that is not a UUID answers 404 unread; a reading of another organization answers 403.

post.summary: Register a user
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createUser'), requirePermission('assignRole'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. The 201 returns the created user without any credential field. The 400 is an unknown organizationId, a duplicate email or username, an invalid accessType, a caller of several organizations who names no organizationId, or any other untagged error. The 422 is a UserModel.validate failure and carries details. A caller below the level of the role it grants answers 403.

organizationId.description: Required of a caller of several organizations; an organization-scoped caller registers into its own.

accessType.description: The hierarchy level of the role granted.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createUser'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. An organization-scoped caller lists the users of its own organizations only. Each user goes through UserModel.stripSecrets.

Gates: authenticate only; the handler then answers 403 unless the caller is an Administrador or an Auditor (isAuditReader). The 503 comes from authenticate. An invalid source is a 422-tagged error that this handler's catch answers 500, so there is no 422 here.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Also read as userID or user.

parameters.name: userName
parameters.description: Case-insensitive regular expression on the anonymised user identifier.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: live (default) reads logs, archive reads logs_archive. Any other value is read by getLogs as a 422-tagged error that this handler answers as 500.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: One of the sortable log fields; an unrecognised one is ignored.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createUser'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403. The user goes through UserModel.stripSecrets.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

put.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createUser'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403. The 403 is also a move of the user to an organization outside the caller's, a level above the caller's own, and a role change by a caller without assignRole. The 422 is a non-empty password in the body (the password is set by POST /api/users/{id}/set-password) or a validation failure. Every other failure, an unknown organizationId included, answers 400. The MFA fields are dropped from the body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

auditorRole.description: Grants or revokes the additive auditor role.

delete.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createUser'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403. A deactivation: the account is set inactive and its sessions are revoked; the document is kept. The 403 is also a target of a higher level than the caller's.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createUser'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createUser'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

post.summary: Grant a user an organization
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createUser'), requirePermission('assignRole'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. The 201 is a new grant and the 200 an organization already held. The 403 is also an organization outside the caller's. The 404 is a user or an organization not found. The 409 is a target who is an Administrador (global scope) or has no organization-scoped role. The 422 is no organizationId from a global caller (a non-global caller who names none gets 403). The error body is {success, error, message}, with no details.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

404.description: The user, or the organization, was not found.

409.description: The target is an Administrador or has no organization-scoped role.

delete.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createUser'), requirePermission('assignRole', 'UPDATE'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. The 403 is also an organization outside the caller's. The 409 is the user's home organization (changed by PUT /api/users/{id}) or its last organization. An organization the user does not hold answers 200 and changes nothing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

409.description: The home organization, or the last organization, cannot be removed.

post.summary: Register a participant
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createPatient'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. clinicalUnitId is resolved by the create rule for an organization-scoped caller. The 400 is any untagged failure or a caller of several organizations who names no clinicalUnitId; the 422 carries details.

patientName.description: Civil identity, stored on the participant identity only. Required and non-blank.

birthDate.description: Civil identity, stored on the participant identity only. Required; DD/MM/YYYY (day first, read the same way as the duplicate check and search) or an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

identityDocument.description: Civil identity document, normalised and checked for a duplicate (a conflict answers 400). Optional.

post.summary: Register a sample
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('createSample'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. The 201 is complete; the 202 sets partialSuccess true because the topology integration was queued. The 403 is also STRICT_MODE_BLOCKED. The 404 is an organizationId a global caller names that does not exist. The 422 is a qualificationContext error or a 422-tagged failure and carries details; every other failure is 400.

boxId.description: The storage box (an object id); required.

positionCode.description: The position in the box; required.

specimenId.description: Generated when omitted; an existing one is refused.

specimenStatus.description: closed cannot be assigned at registration.

organizationId.description: Resolved by the create rule; never stored from the body as such.

qualificationContext.description: The use context checked by RF018 AC2.

202.description: The sample was registered and its topology integration queued.

post.summary: Record a sample withdrawal
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('withdrawSample', 'UPDATE'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. The 403 is also a sample of another organization. The 400 is a missing sampleID, a consent refusal, or any failure of the withdrawal.

requiredScope.description: The consent scope to check; consentScope is read as an alias.

schema.description: Every other field is passed to sampleService.withdrawSample.

post.summary: Request a report
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('viewReports'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. The report is stored as pending, stamped with the caller's organizations.

post.summary: Register a sensor
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('manageSensor'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. The 400 includes a caller of several organizations who names no organizationId and an unknown organization; there is no 404. The 422 is a validation failure and carries details.

post.summary: Reset or unlock the MFA of a user
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('resetMFA', 'UPDATE'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403. For an Administrador target the enrolment is kept and only the lock counters are cleared (unlockedOnly true); for any other target the second factor is removed and the sessions are revoked.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

200.description: The MFA was unlocked (Administrador target) or reset.

post.summary: Revoke the sessions of a user
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('revokeSessions', 'UPDATE'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403. The 422 is a reason other than admin_action or risk.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

post.summary: Force a password reset at the next login
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('forcePasswordReset', 'UPDATE'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

post.summary: Set the password of a user
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('setUserPassword', 'UPDATE'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403. The password is checked for strength and reuse (422), the user must replace it at next login, and the sessions are revoked.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

post.summary: Disable the MFA of an Administrador
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requirePermission('disableMFA', 'UPDATE'), requireOrganizationScope. The 503 comes from authenticate. A user outside the caller's organizations answers 403. The 403 is also a caller who is not an Administrador, and a target who is not an Administrador. The enrolment is kept for re-activation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user: its _id, id or userID.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4), both as router.use: Administrador only. The 503 comes from authenticate.

put.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4), both as router.use: Administrador only. The 503 comes from authenticate. The 400 and 422 are a refused validation run (422 when a governance invariant is violated, 400 otherwise) and add configurationValidationRunId and violatedInvariants; any other untagged failure is also 400. The 409 is another change activated first.

schema.description: Any of the eight groups; other top-level keys are not stored.

400.description: Invalid input or a refused validation run.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4), both as router.use: Administrador only. The 503 comes from authenticate. One entry per configuration key.
Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4), both as router.use: Administrador only. The 503 comes from authenticate. Newest first.

post.summary: Roll the configuration back to a release
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4), both as router.use: Administrador only. The 503 comes from authenticate. The rollback is recorded as a new release. The 400 is a missing configurationReleaseId or a refused validation run, the 422 an invariant violation as in PUT /api/security/config. The 404 is a release not found for this profile. The 409 is a release never activated, already active, or a concurrent activation.

409.description: The release was never activated, is already active, or a concurrent activation won.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4), both as router.use: Administrador only. The 503 comes from authenticate.

get.summary: Get the consent notification queue status
get.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4), both as router.use: Administrador only. The 503 comes from authenticate.

Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4), both as router.use: Administrador only. The 503 comes from authenticate. The 200 is not wrapped in Success: text/csv by default, an application/json array for any other format, both with Content-Disposition: attachment. The 422 is a source other than live or archive and carries details.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: csv (default); any other value gives JSON.

200.description: The exported logs, as an attachment.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account.
Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account. The recovery codes themselves are never listed.
Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account.

put.description: Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account. The other sessions are revoked. Every failure of the service answers 400.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account. No session token is returned.

delete.summary: Revoke every session but the current
delete.description: Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account.

get.description: Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account.

post.summary: Generate recovery codes
post.description: Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account. The plaintext codes are shown once; the stored hashes are never returned.

delete.description: Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account.

post.summary: Request a password reset
post.description: Gates: authenticate, applied with router.use. The 503 comes from authenticate. It acts on the caller's own account. The 403 is also a deployment where password reset is disabled (the body is PASSWORD_RESET_DISABLED). The 400 is an expirationHours outside 0.25 to 24 or a failure of the service.

bearerAuth.description: Authorization: Bearer <access token>, the token login and refresh return.

telemetryIngestSecret.name: x-telemetry-ingest-secret
telemetryIngestSecret.description: The machine-ingest secret (TELEMETRY_INGEST_SECRET) a device sends instead of a session.

testSupportSecret.name: x-test-support-secret
testSupportSecret.description: The test-support secret (TEST_SUPPORT_SECRET) of the telemetry-monitor test routes.

items.description: A text, or a coded concept { text } or { coding }.

postRetentionAction.description: Only archive is accepted for AuditEvent.

archiveRetentionPeriod.description: An ISO 8601 duration no shorter than retentionPeriod; with archiveRetentionBasis, only for postRetentionAction archive.

archiveRetentionBasis.description: The legal or regulatory obligation the archive period rests on.

AccessPolicyInput.description: One version of an access policy. The five array fields of applicableEntityTypes, roleCodes, organizationScopeIds, resourceScopes and conditions must be non-empty. An accessPolicyId in the body is ignored.

items.description: A non-empty object of fact -> required value; the facts are consent, duo, study, organizationId, studyId, protocolId, requestedPurpose and duoCode.

NotificationRuleInput.description: A notification rule. A version in the body is ignored: the server numbers it (v1, v2, ...).

sensitiveFieldsAllowlist.description: The payload fields a message may carry; empty or absent means none.

active.description: Defaults to true; an active rule deactivates the other active rules of its eventType.

id.description: The same id as a string.

status.description: Translated for the client (Ativo, Inativo, Bloqueado, Suspenso).

roleName.description: Resolved from the active role assignment.

auditorRole.description: Whether the additive auditor role is held.

roleValidFrom.description: Start of the role validity window.

roleValidUntil.description: End of the role validity window.

UserRecord.description: A user account as the routes return it, after UserModel.stripSecrets: no credential, hash, MFA secret, password history or reset-token field is present.

global.description: True for an Administrador, whose scope is every organization.

BadRequest.description: Invalid or missing input, or the operation failed.

Unauthorized.description: No, invalid or expired token or session, or an inactive account; on login, refused credentials.

Forbidden.description: Access denied: the permission or role gate refused, the role assignment expired, or MFA setup is pending.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Validation failed; details lists each reason.
